description: This file implements the core Netlink communication mechanisms for Linux-based systems, including serialization, deserialization, sending, and receiving Netlink messages, as well as managing pending message queues and socket interactions within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles serialization, deserialization, and management of Netlink messages, including sequence ID tracking.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages socket communication for Netlink, including sending and receiving data, and handling pending message queues.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming byte stream into Netlink message components.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket, with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message and waits for a response, facilitating request-response communication.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares and retrieves data to be sent over the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data received from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the socket connection.
